text:
raj: Quick follow-up from the KV eviction postmortem — I want to lock owners/timelines for the test coverage work that came out of the incident. Proposing: (1) focused regression suite for prefix/KV patterns, (2) promptset of eviction-edge prompts, (3) sustained load + small chaos drill. Who can own what?
linda: I can take the promptset curation. Will assemble ~200 edge prompts (short/long prefixes + truncation cases). Target EOD next Tue. :calendar:
ben: I can own the regression suite packaging and CI integration. Plan: add a nightly job in the regression pipeline and a lightweight canary on main. ETA 2 weeks.
susan: For sustained load + chaos drill, ops-team will run a staged run and a KV eviction toggle. Need a clear playbook for rollback and measurement signals. I can schedule a dry run next Wed.
raj: Thanks — can you add the desired success criteria? e.g., percentage of requests served without fallback, 95th latency delta threshold, and KV miss rate?
susan: Proposed criteria: fallback rate < 1% for the test profile, 95p latency increase < 30% vs baseline, and KV miss spike contained to < 5x baseline. I'll put metrics in the runbook.
maria: We'll need model/quantization variants to be included in the regression matrix. Suggest sampling small/med/large model configs. ben, can the CI matrix handle that without blowing up cost?
ben: Yes — we'll add matrix sampling: small and med for nightly, full matrix for weekly. Cost estimate in PR.
raj: ops-bot, create task tracker items for these owners and link to postmortem?
ops-bot: Created tasks: PF-321 (promptset) -> owner: linda, due 2026-04-07; PF-322 (regression CI) -> owner: ben, due 2026-04-14; PF-323 (chaos drill runbook) -> owner: susan, due 2026-04-08. Links: https://tasks.internal/PF-321 https://tasks.internal/PF-322 https://tasks.internal/PF-323
kevin: Quick question — do we want load profile to mirror production 99th-peaked traffic or a synthetic worst-case? I'd vote mirror prod with a synthetic spike overlay.
raj: Agree on prod mirror + synthetic spike. Also need to add a repeating recurrence: run the chaos scenario quarterly and the regression matrix weekly. Add owners for recurrence.
linda: I'll own the quarterly verification of promptset coverage and update prompts after each incident.
ben: I'll own the weekly regression maintenance and the cost guard rails.
susan: Ops will own the quarterly chaos execution and post-run runbook updates.
raj: One more ask — tie the eval regressions to PR gating for KV-sensitive code paths. Ben, can you add a gating job that fails PRs touching kv-cache, serving runtime, or router?
ben: Yep — adding a presubmit check that runs the small regression subset on PRs touching those paths. Example matcher: `paths: ["src/serving/kv*", "src/runtime/cache*", "src/router/**"]`.
maria: Also recommend we add a short training doc for SREs on how to interpret the regression diffs (common false positives, signal vs noise). I'll draft one.
raj: Great. Summary of owners/timelines: linda (promptset) due 2026-04-07, ben (regression CI + PR gating) due 2026-04-14, susan (chaos runbook + dry run) due 2026-04-08, maria (SRE doc) due 2026-04-09. Ops-bot already created tasks.
ben: I'll open the PRs tomorrow with the CI jobs and gating rules.
linda: I'll drop the initial prompt spreadsheet in the task and @mention the ML reviewers.
susan: Scheduling dry run for Wed 2026-03-31 10:00 PT. Invite sent to owners.
raj: Thanks team. Let's reconvene after the dry run to confirm success metrics and any changes to recurrence cadence. :thumbsup:
